question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH food_dim AS (
    SELECT
        FOOD_ID,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG)), ' ', '-') IN ('VEG', 'NON-VEG')
                THEN REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG)), ' ', '-')
            END) = 1
            THEN MAX(CASE
                WHEN REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG)), ' ', '-') IN ('VEG', 'NON-VEG')
                THEN REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG)), ' ', '-')
            END)
        END AS FOOD_CLASS
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__FOOD
    GROUP BY FOOD_ID
), line_groups AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN i.F_ID IS NULL OR f.FOOD_ID IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
            WHEN f.FOOD_CLASS = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
            WHEN f.FOOD_CLASS = 'NON-VEG' THEN 'Non-Veg'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS FOOD_GROUP,
        COALESCE(i.QUANTITY, 0) AS ORDERED_UNITS
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM i
    JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o
        ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
    LEFT JOIN food_dim f
        ON i.F_ID = f.FOOD_ID
    WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), groups AS (
    SELECT FOOD_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT, SUM(ORDERED_UNITS) AS ORDERED_UNITS
    FROM line_groups
    GROUP BY FOOD_GROUP
), all_groups AS (
    SELECT column1 AS FOOD_GROUP
    FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
), totals AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ORDERED_UNITS), 0) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS
    FROM line_groups
)
SELECT
    a.FOOD_GROUP,
    COALESCE(g.ITEM_LINE_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT,
    COALESCE(g.ORDERED_UNITS, 0) AS ORDERED_UNITS,
    t.TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS AS TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS_DENOMINATOR,
    100.0 * COALESCE(g.ORDERED_UNITS, 0) / NULLIF(t.TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS, 0) AS SHARE_OF_TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS_PCT
FROM all_groups a
LEFT JOIN groups g ON a.FOOD_GROUP = g.FOOD_GROUP
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY CASE a.FOOD_GROUP WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

action.answer:
For item lines belonging to orders with ORDER_DATE from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, classified by the joined food dimension:

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of total ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 | 27.415082% |
| Unknown (null or unmatched food ID) | 12 | 13 | 0.000106% |

The denominator is **12,230,877 total ordered units** across all three groups. Shares are each group’s ordered units divided by this denominator, multiplied by 100; displayed percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.
